mapper.select: SELECT id, author_id AS authorId, user_id AS userId, legal_name_ciphertext AS legalNameCiphertext, date_of_birth_ciphertext AS dateOfBirthCiphertext, identity_type AS identityType, identity_number_ciphertext AS identityNumberCiphertext, identity_number_hash AS identityNumberHash, identity_number_last4 AS identityNumberLast4, tax_code_ciphertext AS taxCodeCiphertext, bank_code AS bankCode, bank_account_ciphertext AS bankAccountCiphertext, bank_account_hash AS bankAccountHash, bank_account_last4 AS bankAccountLast4, bank_account_name_ciphertext AS bankAccountNameCiphertext, consent_version AS consentVersion, consented_at AS consentedAt, status, submission_version AS submissionVersion, submitted_at AS submittedAt, rejection_reason AS rejectionReason FROM author_kyc_profile WHERE author_id = #{authorId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO author_kyc_profile (author_id, user_id, legal_name_ciphertext, date_of_birth_ciphertext, identity_type, identity_number_ciphertext, identity_number_hash, identity_number_last4, tax_code_ciphertext, bank_code, bank_account_ciphertext, bank_account_hash, bank_account_last4, bank_account_name_ciphertext, consent_version, consented_at, status, submission_version, submitted_at) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{userId}, #{legalNameCiphertext}, #{dateOfBirthCiphertext}, #{identityType}, #{identityNumberCiphertext}, #{identityNumberHash}, #{identityNumberLast4}, #{taxCodeCiphertext}, #{bankCode}, #{bankAccountCiphertext}, #{bankAccountHash}, #{bankAccountLast4}, #{bankAccountNameCiphertext}, #{consentVersion}, #{consentedAt}, 'PENDING', 1, #{submittedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE author_kyc_profile SET legal_name_ciphertext = #{legalNameCiphertext}, date_of_birth_ciphertext = #{dateOfBirthCiphertext}, identity_type = #{identityType}, identity_number_ciphertext = #{identityNumberCiphertext}, identity_number_hash = #{identityNumberHash}, identity_number_last4 = #{identityNumberLast4}, tax_code_ciphertext = #{taxCodeCiphertext}, bank_code = #{bankCode}, bank_account_ciphertext = #{bankAccountCiphertext}, bank_account_hash = #{bankAccountHash}, bank_account_last4 = #{bankAccountLast4}, bank_account_name_ciphertext = #{bankAccountNameCiphertext}, consent_version = #{consentVersion}, consented_at = #{consentedAt}, status = 'PENDING', submission_version = submission_version + 1, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, reviewed_at = NULL, reviewed_by = NULL, rejection_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND status = 'REJECTED' AND submission_version = #{submissionVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO author_kyc_audit (kyc_profile_id, author_id, user_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, reason) VALUES (#{kycProfileId}, #{authorId}, #{userId}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT id, withdrawal_no AS withdrawalNo, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, hold_idempotency_key AS holdIdempotencyKey, author_id AS authorId, user_id AS userId, requested_xu AS requestedXu, gross_amount_vnd AS grossAmountVnd, withheld_tax_vnd AS withheldTaxVnd, net_amount_vnd AS netAmountVnd, bank_code AS bankCode, bank_account_last4 AS bankAccountLast4, status, release_target_status AS releaseTargetStatus, payout_provider AS payoutProvider, requested_at AS requestedAt, rejection_reason AS rejectionReason, version FROM author_withdrawal_request WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO author_withdrawal_request (withdrawal_no, idempotency_key, author_id, user_id, kyc_profile_id, requested_xu, vnd_per_xu, gross_amount_vnd, withheld_tax_vnd, net_amount_vnd, bank_code, bank_account_ciphertext, bank_account_last4, bank_account_name_ciphertext, hold_idempotency_key, status, payout_provider, requested_at) VALUES (#{withdrawalNo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{authorId}, #{userId}, #{kycProfileId}, #{requestedXu}, #{vndPerXu}, #{grossAmountVnd}, 0, #{grossAmountVnd}, #{bankCode}, #{bankAccountCiphertext}, #{bankAccountLast4}, #{bankAccountNameCiphertext}, #{holdIdempotencyKey}, 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'MANUAL_BANK', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
